definitions.explanation: A substance used to prevent or eliminate pests, insects, or plant diseases, especially in agriculture and gardening.

examples.japanese: ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{防除剤|ぼうじょざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まく。
examples.english: to spread pest-control agent on the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{防除剤|ぼうじょざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧。
examples.english: This pesticide works well against harmful insects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{防除剤|ぼうじょざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らした→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
examples.english: To avoid overusing agrochemicals, I reduced the amount of pest-control agent.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防除|ぼうじょ}→防除：24687_boujo⟧ ('prevention and extermination') + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ ('agent, preparation'). Refers to substances used to control agricultural pests, insects, and plant diseases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防除剤|ぼうじょざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散布|さんぷ}する→散布する：21621_sanpusuru⟧: to spray a pest-control agent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殺虫剤|さっちゅうざい}→殺虫剤：07036_sacchuuzai⟧: insecticide — targets insects specifically
- ⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧: agricultural chemical — the broader category
